rows.en: Sisk: "We have the residence in sight.
There are Prana readings... Armored Mechs!"
Xiujian: "How many?"
Sisk: "Their numbers... The readings are being jammed,
so I can't tell for sure...
but I don't think it's a large force."
Ai: "So they were on guard."
Clovis: "Well, they've got that much to hide.
It's like they're advertising that they're here."
Xiujian: "It could be a trap."
Touya: "No point worrying over it here.
Let's just do everything we can!"
Captain Roa: "Hmm!"
Baren: "...Understood. Course 1249, the presidential residence!"
Clovis: "Oh... What a grand welcome."
Derock: "It looks like they've imposed a strict alert.
A government that does that will collapse before long."
Xiujian: "But it hasn't collapsed yet.
First, we need to think about how to deal with the situation before us."
Clovis: "Yeah. We'll make plenty of noise until he
secures the president."
Touya: "What about the signal?"
Clovis: "Sisk, anything?"
Sisk: "Nothing in particular..."
Miyasco: "...He... will begin acting shortly..."
Sisk: "Huh? Miyasco?"
Miyasco: "...Oh... Huh? I'm sorry, I...
But I really did get that feeling..."
Yamato: "I see. Thought transmission...
They're both ability users, so they can do that.
This way, the other side won't notice."
Clovis: "Yeah. Then let's begin."
Touya: "All right, here we go!"
Ai: "Touya. I'll do things my way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time I'll be acting
on my own."
Clovis: "I'll act independently. I'm leaving the rest to you."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I'm not ready to put my life in your hands.
I'll do things my way."
Xiujian: "...I don't intend to follow your orders.
I'll act on my own."
Celica: "Sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
Fain: "The burning spirit of justice
has yet to take root in you! I cannot follow such a person's orders!
So I'll follow my own justice! That's all!"
Melissa: "This time, I'll act on my own for a bit."
Kururu: "I'll fight the way I like."
Leone: "I'm not confident I can follow your orders properly, Touya,
so let me act freely this time."
Horem: "They've come after all..."
Steinies: "Hey, are you really sending him out?
What if he wakes up partway through...?"
Horem: "It'll be fine. That drug is perfect.
And if anything happens, you can dispose of him."
Steinies: "No thanks. You saw how much trouble he gave me earlier...
If you're doing it, do it now. Otherwise, don't look at me."
Horem: "...I see. Well, very well.
We still have a trump card."
Steinies: "A trump card?"
Horem: "Heh heh... It's a secret.
Look forward to it."
Steinies: "Tch. Playing it up, huh...
Fine. I'll head out too.
You can stay here and enjoy the show."
Horem: "Heh heh... The greater the fool, the easier to control...
Do buy me as much time as you can..."
Yamato: "Hey, Touya. I'm sure you know this, but
don't be too quick to count on replenishing your Pranya."
Touya: "Replenishing?"
Yamato: "The 'kiss'! A 'kiss'! You can't use it right away,
but it's the one you can use when your Pranya gets low."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... I know."
Yamato: "Really? A girl's lips
don't come that cheap, you know."
Touya: "I don't want to take it lightly either."
Yamato: "Then that's fine."
Miyasco: "Everyone, Reamond says he'll begin acting
once the Armored Mech force is down to half!"
Xiujian: "Half...? I see.
If we gain the advantage, the president will try to flee...
He intends to use that confusion."
Miyasco: "Yes. Fortunately, the military is in confusion,
but if we take too long, they could intervene.
It'll be a tough battle, but do your best!"
Ai: "To them, we're invaders, after all."
Xiujian: "We can leave judgments about us
to future historians. We do what must be done now... That's all."
Touya: "Heh! That's right.
All right, let's go!"
Yamato: "...He's late... We should have heard from him
by now..."
Touya: "Don't tell me something happened inside...?"
Yamato: "At worst, we may have to consider that he escaped..."
Ai: "If he escapes now, he'll be even more cautious next time...
Touya, we're going in!"
Touya: "What?!"
Ai: "We can still make it.
He's the worst possible combination of ambition and power.
Who knows what he'll do next?!"
Touya: "That's true, but..."
Ai: "Oh, come on! We're going, now!"
Touya: "Whoa! S-Sit still!
Aah! Don't move it without asking!"
Aurelie: "We need a plan before it comes to that...
There must still be something we can do!"
Touya: "Right. If we give up, it's over."
Aurelie: "Exactly. That's the spirit!
All right, in that case..."
Kururu: "Hey, what happens if he escapes?"
Yamato: "We might never get another chance to corner him like this.
And he'll use large amounts of that drug to unite everyone by force..."
Kururu: "No... Touya! If that happens..."
Touya: "...I'll never let that happen..."
Kururu: "Yeah! That's right!
Oh! Then let's capture the president ourselves!"
Touya: "No, that's... For one thing, you..."
Kururu: "Don't say it's dangerous.
This isn't the time for that, is it?"
Touya: "...Aren't you scared?"
Kururu: "...A little. But you're with me, Touya...
So I'm totally fine!"
Touya: "...Heh. All right, then..."
Touya: "More reinforcements?!"
Yamato: "They seem a little different from the last ones..."
Reamond: "...It's over..."
Touya: "!! H-Hey... Why are you...?"
Reamond: "The president is dead. The list of those involved
and the evidence are in trustworthy hands.
We can rest easy now..."
Touya: "I see... Then we're all right now.
It's all over, right?"
Reamond: "...Yes. Except for me."
Touya: "!? H-Hey, don't tell me..."
Reamond: "Yes. I'll fight you with all my strength.
Then I'll settle everything."
Touya: "W-Wait! I don't understand any of this!
Why do we have to fight you?!"
Reamond: "...You need a reason...?
Then, for Zigrim's future,
I'll dispose of you as obstacles..."
Touya: "You expect me to accept a reason like that?!"
Reamond: "That's your problem.
My will won't change..."
Touya: "It's wrong... It's absolutely wrong!"
Yamato: "Touya..."
Touya: "...That guy..."
Reamond: "...Then here I come!"
Touya: "Hey, is this for real...?"
Yamato: "This is bad... But it shows they're desperate too.
We have to hold out until he secures the president!"
Touya: "Yeah... We're counting on you, Reamond..."
Horem: "Heh heh... What was there wasn't all of it...
Now, while they buy time,
I'll make my escape..."
Reamond: "Where do you intend to go,
President Nell Horem?"
Horem: "...What do you think you're doing, pointing a gun at me,
the head of state?"
Reamond: "Oh? Were you worthy of such respect?
At least no citizen would respect you as you are now."
Horem: "Heh heh... But the only people who know me as I am now are you
and Lieutenant Colonel Mishual. You'll die
in an unfortunate accident... Those stupid citizens are easily handled.
They're inferior creatures who feel safe
as long as they suffer no loss themselves.
Foolish beings who see only the surface...
Truly easy creatures to control.
Besides, aren't you barely able to stand now?
Look, your gun barrel is shaking."
Reamond: "...It's true my body is probably at its limit.
But before that, you'll pay for your crimes.
Surrender quietly."
Horem: "Crimes...? Heh heh... If what I've done is a crime,
isn't your very existence a crime too?"
Reamond: "Yes... I know.
I'll take you into custody, and then
settle things."
Horem: "Oh...? But I'm no hypocrite
like you..."
Reamond: "...Put that gun away.
Don't make me pull this trigger..."
Horem: "...Heh heh... You should just pull it...
I wouldn't hesitate..."
Reamond: "..."
Horem: "Heh heh heh... Goodbye..."
Yamato: "Touya, look... It's Baresios!"
Touya: "Yeah... But the one piloting it
was General Growster, right? Then he must be safe."
Yamato: "This isn't the time for that!
It clearly doesn't look friendly!"
Growster: "..."
Touya: "...It looks like he's being controlled
by that 'drug' after all."
Yamato: "Really, that President Horem
is a rotten bastard!"
Touya: "...Yeah. Using someone like this...
What does he think people are...? I won't forgive him."
Yamato: "Anyway, there's nothing we can do about that now.
Let's avoid the cockpit
and disable the mech."
Touya: "That's our only choice..."
Yamato: "Isn't it about time?"
Touya: "Huh? For what?"
Yamato: "The infiltration!"
Touya: "Oh, right. The enemy's down to half or less.
We'll silence the ones still out here."
Yamato: "Yes."
Touya: "Damn..."
Reamond: "...This is the end..."
Touya: "U... Uoooooh!!"
Reamond: "...Heh..."
Yamato: "Huh? He didn't dodge...?"
Touya: "Y-You... So you were..."
Reamond: "...Now, everything will end..."
Yamato: "Huh? Griol...?"
Reamond: "Lieutenant Colonel..."
Fores: "Reamond!"
Fores: "You idiot! Leaving without asking,
trying to die without asking...
How much trouble do you have to cause me before you're satisfied?!"
Reamond: "You don't have to call me an idiot...
I was worried about your health, Lieutenant Colonel..."
Fores: "So you drugged me and put me to sleep?!"
Reamond: "You'd have followed me otherwise, right?"
Fores: "Of course! Look at the reckless things
you're doing! Do you know how worried I've been...?"
Reamond: "...Thank you...
But this is goodbye..."
Fores: "Don't decide it's over by yourself!
You're too selfish... Appearing in my life whenever you wanted,
meddling whenever you wanted...
Then selfishly... selfishly taking up residence in my heart!"
Reamond: "...Those words alone are enough...
Lieutenant Colonel, I'm truly glad I met you..."
Yamato: "Look out! That mech is about to explode!"
Fores: "..."
Reamond: "L-Lieutenant Colonel, what are you doing?! Get away, quickly!"
Fores: "...No."
Yamato: "Are you crazy?!
Opening the cockpit hatch like that!"
Reamond: "Lieutenant Colonel! Close the hatch!"
Fores: "..."
Reamond: "...Damn!"
Yamato: "Ah! It's too late!"
Touya: "...What the hell...?"
Yamato: "Touya! Look!"
Reamond: "...Honestly... You're a reckless woman..."
Fores: "That makes two of us."
Reamond: "Heh heh... Quite right, quite right..."
Touya: "...They seem to be safe."
Yamato: "Yes. And it's all settled outside too. Everything's resolved!"
Steinies: "Heh heh heh... What a farce...
Well, fine. If he croaked, that should be the end of it.
...But I'm still here...
You don't get to experience a battle like this very often!
Heh heh... I haven't felt this thrill in ages... Heh heh!"
Yamato: "Touya, it's too soon to relax!"
Zigrim Soldier: "...Ugh..."
Touya: "?"
Zigrim Soldier: "........Wh-Where am I...?"
Yamato: "Oh! Looks like they've come to their senses!"
Touya: "Yeah. For now, it looks like we've avoided
an unnecessary battle..."
Yamato: "Touya, it's too soon to relax!"
Growster: "...Ugh..."
Touya: "?"

Hmm? That's Rayblade..."
Yamato: "Oh! Looks like he's come to his senses!"
Touya: "Yeah. For now, it looks like we've avoided
